items.title: phpAfterShell Vulnerability Revives PHP2Shell’s Attack Path
items.description: If a session overwrite operation is interrupted, an attacker who controls the fresh data could trigger data deserialization and RCE. The post phpAfterShell Vulnerability Revives PHP2Shell’s Attack Path appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.description: Attackers abused a flaw in the GoodCloud remote management service to push malware to devices, and cleaning them requires new firmware. The post GL.iNet Routers, KVMs Compromised via Remote Management Service Flaw appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Critical binary-parser Flaw Enables JavaScript Injection via Malicious Parser Definitions
items.description: A critical security flaw has been disclosed in the popular binary-parser library that could allow an attacker who controls parser definitions to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-134814 (CVSS score: 9.2 / 8.1), is a case of code injection impacting binary-parser versions prior to 2.3.1.
